unchanged_design: Catalogue, checkpoints, delta, price grid, horizons and self-audit dimensions remain those of plan_v2; only the actual source revision and fresh random streams change.
reason: V2 can exhaust after price preflight before catalogue admission, then return unvalidated profile.names[0]. V3 uses the public fixed fallback, withholds profile identity until exact scope/range/catalogue verification, and avoids copying oversized negative integers before rejection.
preservation: V1/V2 sources, review probes and all runs are retained; default-budget old numerical data are not relabeled as v3.
